verdict.rationale: The only wearable-related evidence is that Authenticator notifications can be mirrored from the phone to a wearable. That is adjacent notification mirroring, not a documented way to read OTP codes on a smartwatch without the phone. Nothing shows a watch app or on-watch code display, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone

citations.quote: you can mirror Authenticator notifications from your phone to your wearable device.
